New Indian Penal Code to limit case duration to three years: Amit Shah

Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced that the implementation of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita will cap the entire legal process, from the filing of a First Information Report (FIR) to a Supreme Court decision, at three years. This new legislation aims to expedite justice delivery.
